feature_context.prompt: Identify the reviewed feature specification to plan

steps.prompt: Prepare the speckit.plan argument string for {{ inputs.feature_context }}. On the first pass, inspect existing planning outputs and record stable IDs for missing required artifacts or unresolved template sections as the progress baseline. On later passes, preserve the latest verify-plan-output findings verbatim in args, including stable ID, artifact_location, violated_requirement or accepted decision, observed_deficiency, and exact_correction; do not rename repeated findings or reduce them to IDs. Use the latest verify-plan-output remaining_ids and their exact file/section details. Return remaining_ids containing those stable file/section gap IDs and args directing the planning skill to create or complete those outputs within the reviewed specification, preserve completed design and existing decisions, ask the operator for substantive product decisions, and report artifact paths, checks, and any blocker. Do not generate tasks or invoke another FlowKit workflow. Preserve the independent Reviewer findings without performing the review yourself.

Use these pre-pass gap IDs as the progress baseline: {{ steps.prepare-plan-request.output.remaining_ids }}. Independently review the planning outputs for {{ inputs.feature_context }} against the core planning skill's required deliverables, approved specification, repository constraints, and prior findings. Inspect plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, and contracts when required by the feature. Check required files, substantive content, unresolved placeholders, design consistency with the specification, stated tradeoffs and risks, and an actionable validation approach. Accept explicit, justified not-applicable sections; do not invent requirements or expand scope. Return a structured outcome envelope with state complete, continue, or blocked; a stable reason_code; repository-relative evidence paths with current SHA-256 digests; remaining_ids identifying each exact missing, incomplete, or inconsistent deliverable and its evidence; resolved_ids identifying gaps from the prepared baseline or prior verification now filled; and exactly one of next_step_id or resume_action as required. Include an existing specification as evidence when an output file is missing. Use complete only when required outputs are substantive and the independent review finds no material gap. Use continue when exact gaps are safely repairable by speckit.plan and set next_step_id to prepare-plan-request. Use blocked for a required operator decision or a concrete prerequisite, failed constitutional gate, or unsafe retry, with a stable resume_action. Preserve the exact operator question or blocker in the report. Return findings as a separate workflow-specific result alongside the strict assessment envelope, with stable ID, artifact_location, violated_requirement or accepted decision, observed_deficiency, and exact_correction for each semantic defect. Fresh review must confirm substantive resolution of each prior finding and retain new blocking findings. Wording-only or digest-only edits, renamed or repeated findings, and successful commands do not prove resolution. Preserve an unanswered product question verbatim for same-child operator relay or blocked recovery; never infer its answer. Command success or changed bytes alone is not completion or progress. Routing fields are state-dependent. For `complete`, omit `next_step_id`, `gate_step_id`, and `resume_action`; for `continue`, include only `next_step_id` targeting a declared loop-body step; for `blocked`, include only a stable `resume_action`. Never include a routing field for `complete`. Both `reason_code` and `resume_action` must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` (lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens; never use underscores or spaces).

Report the latest verified planning outcome for {{ inputs.feature_context }} and present the generated design artifacts for operator review. Identify exact missing files or sections, any blocker or operator question, and the safe resumption action when incomplete. No progress or exhaustion of the five-pass safety limit is a bounded stop, not planning completion. Stop this workflow here. Task generation requires a separate operator invocation.

workflow.author: pegagio
workflow.description: Run the planning skill and retry missing or placeholder outputs until populated or a bounded stop.
workflow.name: Plan Implementation
